descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S12 「护士长名单上两个字母和三个字母的姓不会被一声不响地丢掉」 Two- and three-letter surnames on the supervisor list are not dropped without a word

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 3；TFA-92587 How it works 3）
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. …（UAT TC-09；UAT TC-02 (by reference)；TFA-92587 AC 3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Fresh physician; fixture resident only

When Scan a supervisor list whose rows include a 2-letter surname ('Ng') and a 3-letter one ('Ngo') → keep every row selected → confirm → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then The sheet lists all three rows, or says in words that 'Ng' could not be read. A row that disappears without a message is a Fail (U3, AC 3 'never silently dropping'). After confirming, Ng, Ngo and QA Pax are on Today's Visits

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: s12-sheet has '3 residents found' and 'Oak 5' (Ng's row); s12-today has 'Oak 5', 'Oak 6' and 'QA Pax' and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓'; s12-all has 'Oak 5' and 'In Today ✓' (U2, U3). On main 'Ng' is dropped before the sheet, so a Fail is expected. If the app instead flags the row as unreadable in words, a person judges it (manual)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
